narration:1:1760008001:0.text: As your new friends from the Digital World don't have permission to enter the campus, you contact Zorya beforehand on your communicator to give her a heads-up.
narration:1:1760008001:0.source_cn: 由于太一、大和、亚古兽没有入校许可，你提前使用魔法通讯...
narration:1:1760008001:0.male: As your new friends from the Digital World don't have permission to enter the campus, you contact Zorya beforehand on your communicator to give her a heads-up.
narration:1:1760008001:0.female: As your new friends from the Digital World don't have permission to enter the campus, you contact Zorya beforehand on your communicator to give her a heads-up.

narration:2:1760008002:0.text: After learning the details, Zorya uses her authority as headmistress to grant them campus access.
narration:2:1760008002:0.source_cn: 得知来龙去脉后，佐尔娅通过校长权限，她向众人发出了邀请...

narration:3:1760008003:0.text: You enter the Serene Lyceum and find Zorya already waiting...
narration:3:1760008003:0.source_cn: 你们畅通无阻地进入了莱希拉姆，而佐尔娅也早已在此等候你们……
narration:3:1760008003:0.male: You enter the Serene Lyceum and find Zorya already waiting...
narration:3:1760008003:0.female: You enter the Serene Lyceum and find Zorya already waiting...

say:7:1760008004:1.text: Good to see you, Merlin. Are these the new friends Taichi, Yamato, and Agumon you told me about?
say:7:1760008004:1.source_cn: 你来了，梅林。他们就是你提到的太一、大和与亚古兽？
say:7:1760008004:1.male: Good to see you, Merlin. Are these the new friends Taichi, Yamato, and Agumon you told me about?
say:7:1760008004:1.female: Good to see you, Merlin. Are these the new friends Taichi, Yamato, and Agumon you told me about?

say:8:1760008005:1.text: Have you seen Gabumon? That's my Partner...
say:8:1760008005:1.source_cn: 是的。你见过加布兽吗？那是我非常重要的同伴……

say:10:1760008007:0.source_cn: 真的吗？！是在哪里看见的？

say:11:1760008008:0.text: A couple of days ago, that creature fell from the sky and landed in the graveyard. He claimed to be from a place called the Digital World and said he was looking for someone named Yamato Ishida.
say:11:1760008008:0.source_cn: 数天前，那只生物掉落在墓园，自称来自数码世界，在寻找名...

say:14:1760008009:0.text: I sensed peculiar energy within him, and I noticed he knew nothing about Esperia.
say:14:1760008009:0.source_cn: 加布兽体内蕴含着奇异的能量，且对伊索米亚大陆的常识一无所知。

say:15:1760008010:0.text: I felt it would be unwise to let him leave the campus.
say:15:1760008010:0.source_cn: 若贸然放其离开莱希拉姆、四处闯荡，可能造成严重的负面影响。

say:16:1760008011:0.text: Therefore, I advised him to remain here for the time being and attend classes to learn the basics of Esperia.
say:16:1760008011:0.source_cn: 故此，我建议加布兽暂时留在学校，通过上课等方式恶补一下常识。

say:17:1760008012:0.source_cn: 所以，加布兽现在还在学校里吗？

say:18:1760008013:0.text: As far as I know, yes. Gabumon is very hardworking and rarely leaves the classroom.
say:18:1760008013:0.source_cn: 据我所知，是的。加布兽很努力，几乎不曾离开教室。

say:19:1760008014:0.text: That's one thing you could learn from Gabumon, Merlin.
say:19:1760008014:0.source_cn: 关于这一点，梅林，或许你应该向加布兽学习。
say:19:1760008014:0.male: That's one thing you could learn from Gabumon, Merlin.
say:19:1760008014:0.female: That's one thing you could learn from Gabumon, Merlin.

choice_prompt:20:1760008014.text: That's one thing you could learn from Gabumon, Merlin.
choice_prompt:20:1760008014.source_cn: 关于这一点，梅林，或许你应该向加布兽学习。
choice_prompt:20:1760008014.male: That's one thing you could learn from Gabumon, Merlin.
choice_prompt:20:1760008014.female: That's one thing you could learn from Gabumon, Merlin.

say:21:1760008015:0.text: Finally, a lead! Let's go find Gabumon!
say:21:1760008015:0.source_cn: 终于找到线索了！各位，我们快去找加布兽吧！

narration:24:1760008016:0.text: You rush to the classroom, only to be met with two pieces of bad news.
narration:24:1760008016:0.source_cn: 你们赶到了教室。迎接你们的，是一个坏消息，和另一个坏消息
narration:24:1760008016:0.male: You rush to the classroom, only to be met with two pieces of bad news.
narration:24:1760008016:0.female: You rush to the classroom, only to be met with two pieces of bad news.

narration:25:1760008017:1.text: Firstly, there is no sign of Gabumon in the classroom.
narration:25:1760008017:1.male: Firstly, there is no sign of Gabumon in the classroom.
narration:25:1760008017:1.female: Firstly, there is no sign of Gabumon in the classroom.

narration:26:1760008018:1.text: Then, you come across a squad of Lyceum Guards on the hunt for Gabumon.
narration:26:1760008018:1.male: Then, you come across a squad of Lyceum Guards on the hunt for Gabumon.
narration:26:1760008018:1.female: Then, you come across a squad of Lyceum Guards on the hunt for Gabumon.

say:29:1760008019:0.text: Target: Gabumon. Violation Level: Major. Repeat. Target: Gabumon. Violation Level: Major.
say:29:1760008019:0.source_cn: 警报：寻找严重违规者，加布兽。重复：寻找严重违规者，加布兽。

say:30:1760008020:0.text: Order: Apprehension on sight and transfer to the detention room. Detention term: Three years.
say:30:1760008020:0.source_cn: 命令：即刻抓捕，遣送禁闭室。禁闭时限：三年。

choice_prompt:31:1760008020.text: Order: Apprehension on sight and transfer to the detention room. Detention term: Three years.
choice_prompt:31:1760008020.source_cn: 命令：即刻抓捕，遣送禁闭室。禁闭时限：三年。

say:32:1760008021:0.text: We can't let the guards get to Gabumon!
say:32:1760008021:0.source_cn: 不能让守卫们抓住加布兽！

say:35:1760008022:1.text: Gabumon will pass out from starvation if he gets locked up for three years...
say:35:1760008022:1.source_cn: 要被关三年禁闭的话，加布兽可能会因为太饿晕倒的……

say:36:1760008023:1.text: There's got to be some mistake. Gabumon has always been well-behaved!
say:36:1760008023:1.source_cn: 等等，肯定是哪里有误会，加布兽才不会做这种事！

say:37:1760008024:1.text: What specific school rules are there? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this has to be a misunderstanding.
say:37:1760008024:1.male: What specific school rules are there? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this has to be a misunderstanding.
say:37:1760008024:1.female: What specific school rules are there? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this has to be a misunderstanding.

choice_prompt:39:1760008024.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，这里的校规是什么？会不会是判定出错了？
choice_prompt:39:1760008024.male: What specific school rules are there? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this has to be a misunderstanding.
choice_prompt:39:1760008024.female: What specific school rules are there? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this has to be a misunderstanding.

narration:40:1760008025:1.text: With the others in tow, you leave the classroom and head for the library...
narration:40:1760008025:1.male: With the others in tow, you leave the classroom and head for the library...
narration:40:1760008025:1.female: With the others in tow, you leave the classroom and head for the library...

say:41:1760008026:1.text: The library is also crawling with guards searching for Gabumon. You weave around them and hurry over to the rulebook.
say:41:1760008026:1.source_cn: 图书馆中也有不少正四处搜寻加布兽的守卫。你们绕过守卫，...
say:41:1760008026:1.male: The library is also crawling with guards searching for Gabumon. You weave around them and hurry over to the rulebook.
say:41:1760008026:1.female: The library is also crawling with guards searching for Gabumon. You weave around them and hurry over to the rulebook.

say:42:1760008027:1.text: After offering the rulebook a perfunctory bow, a flipping sound soon follows...
say:42:1760008027:1.source_cn: 象征性地向校规书行礼后，一阵翻书声响起……
say:42:1760008027:1.male: After offering the rulebook a perfunctory bow, a flipping sound soon follows...
say:42:1760008027:1.female: After offering the rulebook a perfunctory bow, a flipping sound soon follows...

say:45:1760008028:1.text: *Yawn*... Who woke me up this early?

say:46:1760008029:1.text: Well, if it isn't my dear Merlin! It's been a while. Care for a round of tabletop games with me?
say:46:1760008029:1.source_cn: 喔，原来是小梅林。好久不见啊，来找我玩游戏的吗？
say:46:1760008029:1.male: Well, if it isn't my dear Merlin! It's been a while. Care for a round of tabletop games with me?
say:46:1760008029:1.female: Well, if it isn't my dear Merlin! It's been a while. Care for a round of tabletop games with me?

say:49:1760008030:1.text: That lady!!! S-She came out of the book!
say:49:1760008030:1.source_cn: 书、书里，出现了一个女孩子！

say:50:1760008031:0.text: Interesting. You can actually see me?

choice_prompt:51:1760008031.text: Interesting. You can actually see me?

say:53:1760008032:0.text: Ah, got it. I take it you guys and Gabumon are from the same world?
say:53:1760008032:0.source_cn: 哦，我明白啦。你们和加布兽，是来自同一个世界的吧？

say:56:1760008034:0.text: That little troublemaker already broke three school rules within his first few days here. How could I not know him?
say:56:1760008034:0.source_cn: 那个小家伙，刚到莱希拉姆没几天，就违反了三条校规，想不...

choice_prompt:58:1760008034.text: That little troublemaker already broke three school rules within his first few days here. How could I not know him?
choice_prompt:58:1760008034.source_cn: 那个小家伙，刚到莱希拉姆没几天，就违反了三条校规，想不认识才难吧？

say:59:1760008035:0.text: Violation 1: Remaining in the library past closing time despite multiple warnings.
say:59:1760008035:0.source_cn: 首先，是无视守卫的多次警告，闭馆时间仍在图书馆中逗留。

say:60:1760008036:0.text: Violation 2: Unauthorized removal of a magic circle blueprint from the library.
say:60:1760008036:0.source_cn: 其次，是在没有学生徽章的情况下，非法带走了一份珍贵的寻...

say:61:1760008037:1.text: Violation 3: Unauthorized harvesting of magical plants from Skyrealm Forest's greenhouse.
say:61:1760008037:1.source_cn: 最后——就在今天早上，加布兽又跑到了空境森林，私自采集...

say:62:1760008038:1.text: It's been ages since a student has broken so many school rules in one go. This little troublemaker reminds me of you, my dear Merlin!
say:62:1760008038:1.source_cn: 嘻嘻……我很久没见过一下子违反这么多条校规的小家伙啦，...
say:62:1760008038:1.male: It's been ages since a student has broken so many school rules in one go. This little troublemaker reminds me of you, my dear Merlin!
say:62:1760008038:1.female: It's been ages since a student has broken so many school rules in one go. This little troublemaker reminds me of you, my dear Merlin!

say:63:1760008039:1.text: No, this doesn't sound like something Gabumon would do!
say:63:1760008039:1.source_cn: 不对，这其中一定有误会！加布兽很懂事，才不会做这种事！

say:64:1760008040:1.text: Hey, are you trying to contest the fairness of the rules?
say:64:1760008040:1.source_cn: 喂，不要质疑校规的公正性，虽然我一点儿也不想工作，但我...

say:65:1760008041:1.text: *Yawn*... You're lucky I'm in a good mood today, so I'll put your doubts to rest.
say:65:1760008041:1.source_cn: 呵欠……算啦，今天我心情好，就稍微回应一下你的疑问吧。

say:66:1760008042:1.text: I got this footage from the Lyceum guards. It's solid proof of Gabumon's violations.
say:66:1760008042:1.source_cn: 这些是莱希拉姆守卫记录的影像——是加布兽违反校规的铁证。

narration:68:1760008043:1.text: You huddle up and check the footage from Contess...
narration:68:1760008043:1.male: You huddle up and check the footage from Contess...
narration:68:1760008043:1.female: You huddle up and check the footage from Contess...

say:72:1760008044:1.text: I attended a lesson on a tracking spell used to locate lost items...
say:72:1760008044:1.source_cn: 虽然这里的老师说过，使用寻物魔法，就能寻找到自己想要找...

say:73:1760008045:1.text: I figured it might work on people too, so I wanted to use it to find Yamato!
say:73:1760008045:1.source_cn: 寻物魔法……是不是也可以找人？只要用这个魔法，说不定就...

say:74:1760008046:1.text: I also learned that casting a spell requires the correct magic circle, and the blueprint for the tracking spell is kept in the library...
say:74:1760008046:1.source_cn: 我记得他们说，使用魔法需要绘制正确的魔法阵。寻物魔法的...

say:76:1760008047:1.text: The library will be closing soon. Please exit promptly.
say:76:1760008047:1.source_cn: 图书馆即将闭馆，请及时离馆。

say:77:1760008048:1.text: Not this, not this... None of these blueprints is the right one...
say:77:1760008048:1.source_cn: 不对，都不对……这些图纸都不是我要找的……

say:78:1760008049:1.text: ... Wait a minute... This magic circle looks exactly like the one I saw in class! This is it!
say:78:1760008049:1.source_cn: ……等等……这个魔法阵的图案，和课上展示的一样！就是这个！

say:79:1760008050:1.text: The library is now closed. You have violated Article 7, Section 11 of the Serene Lyceum Regulations: Remaining in the library after closing hours without express permission is prohibited.
say:79:1760008050:1.source_cn: 图书馆已到闭馆时间。你已违反莱希拉姆校规第七条第十一款...

say:80:1760008051:1.text: Please leave immediately. Further disciplinary action will follow.
say:80:1760008051:1.source_cn: 请立刻离开图书馆，并接受相应的处罚。

say:81:1760008052:1.text: One more minute, please! I just need to copy down this magic circle!
say:81:1760008052:1.source_cn: 等一下！请再给我一点时间，让我抄下这个魔法阵就好！

say:82:1760008053:1.text: I won't be able to find it again once the bookshelves rearrange themselves tomorrow!
say:82:1760008053:1.source_cn: 不然，明天这些书架变换位置……我又要找不到它了！

say:83:1760008054:1.text: Please... I have to find Yamato as soon as possible! He must be worried sick about me...
say:83:1760008054:1.source_cn: 拜托了，我必须尽快找到大和！我不在，他现在一定很担心……

say:84:1760008055:1.text: Please leave at once! This is your second warning!
say:84:1760008055:1.source_cn: 重复：请立刻离开图书馆！

say:85:1760008056:1.text: Looks like I just have to grab this blueprint and run...
say:85:1760008056:1.source_cn: 没办法了，带上这份图纸逃走吧……

say:86:1760008057:1.text: Sorry... My name is Gabumon. May I borrow this blueprint? I promise I'll return it as soon as I'm done!
say:86:1760008057:1.source_cn: 对不起，我的名字是加布兽，这个图纸可以借我用一下吗？用...

say:87:1760008058:1.text: Target removed important materials from the library. No borrowing record or library card found...
say:87:1760008058:1.source_cn: 检测到目标夹带重要资料离开图书馆；未检测到借阅记录、借...

say:88:1760008059:1.text: Conclusion: Target is in violation of Article 7, Section 20 of the Serene Lyceum Regulations: Unauthorized removal of library materials.
say:88:1760008059:1.source_cn: 判断：目标违反校规第七条第二十款，非法夹带图书馆资料。

say:89:1760008060:1.text: Target: Gabumon. Violation Level: Major. Target fled the library and headed for Skyrealm Forest. Unauthorized entry into the greenhouse.
say:89:1760008060:1.source_cn: 目标姓名：加布兽，严重违规。路径监测：加布兽逃离图书馆...

say:90:1760008061:1.text: I need glimmervines, nightblooms, and mooncrystal grass for the magic circle...
say:90:1760008061:1.source_cn: 绘制寻物魔法法阵需要……流荧藤蔓、夜香花、月晶草……

say:91:1760008062:1.text: ... Found them! Now, let me draw three circuits here, just like in the blueprint, and then...
say:91:1760008062:1.source_cn: ……找到了！接下来，只要按照这张图纸，在这里绘制三条魔...

say:92:1760008063:1.text: Target found. Proceeding with immediate apprehension.
say:92:1760008063:1.source_cn: 检测到目标：加布兽。即刻执行抓捕工作。

say:93:1760008064:1.text: Please, give me a bit more time! I'm almost done drawing the magic circle!
say:93:1760008064:1.source_cn: 等一下！拜托，再给我一点时间，让我绘制完魔法阵就好……!

narration:96:1760008065:0.text: The footage ends here, with the final scene showing Gabumon surrounded by the Lyceum guards...
narration:96:1760008065:0.source_cn: 留影到此为止。最后的画面，停留在加布兽被莱希拉姆守卫团...

say:99:1760008066:0.text: Gabumon, you did all this... for me...
say:99:1760008066:0.source_cn: 加布兽，原来你做的这些……都是为了我……

say:100:1760008067:0.text: Sorry, Gabumon... If only I'd come here sooner...
say:100:1760008067:0.source_cn: 对不起，加布兽，都怪我，我没有及时找到你，让你受了这么...

say:103:1760008068:0.text: Yamato, now's not the time to blame yourself!
say:103:1760008068:0.source_cn: 大和，现在不是自责的时候！

say:104:1760008069:0.text: The guards have captured Gabumon! We need to rescue him!
say:104:1760008069:0.source_cn: 从影像上看，加布兽已经被抓住了，我们必须尽快救加布兽出来！

say:106:1760008071:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please take us to the Skyrealm Forest!

choice:51:0:1.text: Maybe because they're from another world...
choice:51:0:1.source_cn: 应该是他们来自异界的缘故……

choice:51:0:1.female: Maybe because they're from another world...

choice:39:0:1.male: When it comes to school rules, Contess has the final say.
choice:39:0:1.female: When it comes to school rules, Contess has the final say.

choice:39:1:2.text: Let me bring you to Contess.
choice:39:1:2.source_cn: 我带你们去见康缇丝吧
choice:39:1:2.male: Let me bring you to Contess.
choice:39:1:2.female: Let me bring you to Contess.

choice:31:1:2.text: Seriously, how many rules did Gabumon break?
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 加布兽这是违反了多少条校规……
choice:31:1:2.male: Seriously, how many rules did Gabumon break?
choice:31:1:2.female: Seriously, how many rules did Gabumon break?

choice:20:0:1.text: Haha, let's not make this about me...
choice:20:0:1.male: Haha, let's not make this about me...
choice:20:0:1.female: Haha, let's not make this about me...
